newsitem.title: SPAIN: Popular says has bought 2.06 pct of stock.
newsitem.headline: Popular says has bought 2.06 pct of stock.

text.p: Spain's Banco Popular has already bought back 2.06 percent of its stock at a cost of 15.95 million pesetas, Manuel Martin, Argentaria's technical director said on Wednesday.
The bank earlier said it would repurchase up to 4.5 percent of its shares for no more than 35 billion pesetas.
"We still have a lot to do," Martin told journalists at a news conference on first-quarter earnings.
The operation should add two points to the group's return on equity, Martin said.

The purpose of the operation was to improve shareholder value, Martin said, as the share had lagged the sector last year in part because of persistent rumours, which were denied, that Popular would merge with another Spanish bank.
"This is a moderate, well thought-out, conservative operation," Martin said.
